This site map is generated from `_frontend-1/publishing-contract.prompt.md` and maps each page to its publishing protocol and source.

## Content Types

| Type | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **VERBATIM** | Direct transfer of source content into `.qmd` with minimal wrapper/frontmatter work |
| **REDIRECTED** | Transit `.qmd` page that forwards to a copied standalone HTML report |
| **TECHNICAL BRIDGE** | Source-derived page with structural adaptation for web audience/context |
| **NARRATIVE BRIDGE** | Newly authored page synthesized from contract brief + raw sources |
